content.text:
Done! Added two functions to `src/invoices.js`:

- **`addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })`**: Adds a new line or increases qty if SKU already exists. Validates qty and SKU with same error codes as createInvoice. Returns NOT_DRAFT if status isn't 'draft'.

- **`removeLine(invoice, sku)`**: Removes the line with that SKU. Returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU not on invoice, NO_LINES if it's the last line, NOT_DRAFT if not draft status.

Added error codes LINE_NOT_FOUND and NOT_DRAFT to `src/errors.js`. Added 13 tests covering new lines, duplicate SKUs, all error cases, and immutability. All 47 tests pass ✓
